title: feat(cloud-connection)!: refuse marketplace install-local when replicas are declared on the Redis driver
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi968N7B64dDN7Noq8Fj3QSME)_

Fixes #31602

Maintainer ruling R6 on cloud#3814 (2026-11-08 14:16 UTC): 「多副本时拒绝」. Claim 6727409308 (`domain:server#4`, card-thread session_01ADHkmPnqZD15YnBkNbm1jJ).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed, measured on head `6f4c42d9` and, for base, by the ablation that removes the new guard (equivalent to `main` `5d1382a5` on these doors): with `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=3` (or `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) and a composed `cluster` service on the `redis` driver, `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` answered `200` with `hotLoaded: true` and wrote the ledger on base, and `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId` answered `200` and withdrew the package; on head both answer `409 MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` and nothing is written, registered or withdrawn. Every other topology is unchanged. Widened: two published faces gain members, `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` (`@objectstack/spec`) registers `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` under `@objectstack/cloud-connection` (the ledger header's "Registering a new code" rule), and the `@objectstack/service-cluster` root exports `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis`, `composedClusterDriver`, `MULTI_REPLICA_CLUSTER_DRIVER` and `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`; nothing is removed or renamed. This PR takes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review (PASS, 6728523407).
Metadata-protocol: none

**Shared predicate (card item 4, for #31599):** `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis(env, clusterDriver)` in `@objectstack/service-cluster` (`packages/services/service-cluster/src/multi-replica.ts`), with `composedClusterDriver(services)` to read the driver from a kernel context and the code constant `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`. `@objectstack/runtime` already depends on `@objectstack/service-cluster`, so the runtime package doors import it from there.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：部署声明了多副本(`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS` 大于 1 或 `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`)且集群驱动是 Redis 时，市场 install-local 的安装(POST)和卸载(DELETE)直接拒绝，返回 409 `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED`,提示在维护窗口里跑安装脚本、再重启所有副本；不写账本、不热加载、不撤包。
- 为什么改：这两个门只改处理请求的那一个副本(它自己 `OS_HOME` 下的账本和它自己的内核),其他副本永远看不到，而且每个副本启动时只读自己的账本，所以分叉是永久的。维护者 R6 裁决「多副本时拒绝」。
- 风险与回滚：只在"声明多副本 + Redis 驱动"时生效；单节点、内存驱动、其他驱动、没有集群服务时字节不变，split-brain 守卫没动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange` 及两个门里的调用点;`packages/services/service-cluster/src/multi-replica.ts`(共享谓词);`error-code-ledger.zod.ts` 新增的一行和一条 provenance 豁免。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts` —— 预期 27 passed,其中 R6 一组 8 个(4 个拒绝、4 个对照)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(新错误码一行走 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 复核)。

## What changes

- **`packages/services/service-cluster/src/multi-replica.ts`** (new) — the one condition every cloud#3814 card keys on: `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis(env, clusterDriver)` = `declaresMultiNode(env)` (the split-brain guard's own reading, untouched) AND the driver is `MULTI_REPLICA_CLUSTER_DRIVER` (`'redis'`). `composedClusterDriver(services)` reads the composed `cluster` service's `driver` (the `IClusterService.driver` contract field) and never throws. `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` spells the code once, so every door refusing a package change under the condition answers the same code. Exported from the package root; unit pins in `multi-replica.test.ts` (new file: no harness exists for this module).
- **`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`** — `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange(c, ctx, subject)` answers `409` with the code and the recipe ("run the install script, then restart every replica"). Called in `handleInstall` right after `requireInstallCapability` (before the body is read, so before the cloud fetch, the ledger, `manifest.register` and `syncSchemas`) and in `handleUninstall` right after admission (before the ledger lookup, the guards and the withdrawal). The driver is read per request, where it is used. The grant path (`installForGrant`) calls `handleInstall`, so it is covered too.
- **`packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-ledger.ts`** — `sharesCloudBindingCredential` now delegates to `declaresMultiReplicaOnRedis` and `CLOUD_BINDING_SHARED_CLUSTER_DRIVER` aliases `MULTI_REPLICA_CLUSTER_DRIVER`: same answers (its suite is green unchanged), one predicate for the epic.
- **`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`** — `MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` registered under `@objectstack/cloud-connection` (the door), plus one `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` entry for `@objectstack/service-cluster` (the shared constant one package over, the `UNIQUE_SCOPE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` precedent). The claim's surface says "one row"; the waiver is the provenance gate's required companion for a constant defined one package over the door.
- **`content/docs/references/api/{contract,automation-api,error-code-ledger}.mdx`** — regenerated (`gen:schema && gen:docs`) for the new enum member.
- **`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts`** — the shared real-engine install-local harness (AGENTS.md shared-harness rule): `bootPlugin` takes an optional `clusterDriver` that composes a `cluster` service; a new top-level `describe` pins the refusal. No existing test was changed.
- **`.changeset/31602-install-local-multi-replica-refusal.md`** — `patch` for `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/service-cluster`, `@objectstack/spec`; both declaration lines; `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; who sees it.

## Tests

The new describe, on a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` and a real on-disk ledger:

- for each declaration (`OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=3`, `OS_EXPECT_MULTI_NODE=true`) on the `redis` driver: `POST` (inline branch and cloud branch) answers `409 MULTI_REPLICA_PACKAGE_CHANGE_REFUSED` in the declared envelope, the ledger stays empty, the registry holds neither package, and the cloud leg is never fetched; `DELETE` of a package installed on a single node and rehydrated after a restart with replicas declared answers the same `409`, the ledger still holds it and the registry still serves it;
- CONTROLs, install then uninstall both `200` with the ledger and registry moving as before: a single node on `redis`, `OS_CLUSTER_REPLICAS=1` on `redis`, declared replicas on the in-process driver (with the split-brain guard's escape hatch), declared replicas with no cluster service composed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The recipe's wording.** The message names the ruling's recipe verbatim ("run the install script, then restart every replica"). This repository has no deployment install script to point at by name; if the seat wants a concrete command, the wording is one line in `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange`.
- **Dry run is refused too.** `POST` with `dryRun: true` writes nothing, but the guard sits before the body is read, so it is refused like any install: its plan reads the serving replica's own ledger, which is the per-replica state the refusal is about.
- **Sibling doors not in this card.** `POST …/:manifestId/reseed` and `…/purge-sample-data` write rows to the shared database (every replica sees them) and are not refused. The runtime package doors (create/ensure customization, enable, disable, runtime install/uninstall) are #31599, which imports this predicate.
- **A second reader of the same condition stays separate.** `@objectstack/service-cache` (`cache-service-plugin.ts`) reads `declaresMultiNode()` plus its own driver check for the shared Redis cache; it is not moved onto the new predicate here.

## Verification

All on `6f4c42d9` unless stated (the feature commits were cut on `5d1382a5`; `origin/main` merged once at `03fed7a5`, 5 commits, none in these packages; `6f4c42d9` adds only the regenerated references; head `485e8f99` changes only the changeset's prose, after the contract review: the `Clause-②:` line now reads `yes (narrowing)` and names both halves, and the Now bullet says a dry run is refused too. On `485e8f99` the changeset gates were re-run, each exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:nul-bytes`):

<details><summary>Suites (os-verify-lock, every VERDICT command-exit 0)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-cluster test` + `typecheck`: 9 files / 120 tests (`03fed7a5`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: 80 files / 1116 tests; `typecheck` exit 0 (`03fed7a5`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 822 files / 26034 passed, 1 todo; `typecheck` exit 0 (`03fed7a5`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (full battery, narrowing arm): 440 passed, 3 skipped files / 3652 passed, 41 skipped tests (`03fed7a5`).
- Lint (`eslint --no-inline-config`) on `service-cluster`, `cloud-connection`, `spec` sources: exit 0 each.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (negative pins)</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `51cac0fe` (fix committed first), marker `ABLATED_31602`: the guard's condition `|| 'ABLATED_31602'`, so `refuseMultiReplicaPackageChange` always returns `null` (the base behaviour). The test file imports the plugin from `src`, so no rebuild leg. Result: **4 of 27 red** — exactly the four refusal cases (POST and DELETE, both declarations), each `expected 200 to be 409` with the base answer in the message (`{"success":true,"data":{"manifestId":"com.acme.dispatch",…,"hotLoaded":true,…}}` for POST; the withdrawal answer for DELETE); the four CONTROLs and the 19 existing cases green. Restored: blob `4f8e111f` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `6f4c42d9`: 120 families, each run and recorded with its exit code; `--ran` reconciliation: "120 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". All 120 exit 0, among them `check:error-code-provenance`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:api-surface`, `check:generated` and `check:docs`. A first pass on `03fed7a5` had `check:docs` red (the three references above were stale, now regenerated) and two exit-3 prerequisites (`check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed every package's dist, built with `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`); both are green on `6f4c42d9`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0.

</details>
